name: Salto Grande and Mirador Cuernos
region: Torres del Paine National Park, centre
why: The easiest big view in the park: a roaring waterfall, then the Cuernos straight above Lago Nordenskjöld.
book: Park entry online. Starts at the Pudeto catamaran pier.
dangers: The most violent wind of any park trail: hold on to children and hats.

points.name: Pudeto, Lago Pehoé
points.note: The catamaran pier and car park.

points.name: Salto Grande
points.note: 15 minutes: the Paine river falling from Lago Nordenskjöld into Lago Pehoé.

points.name: Mirador Cuernos
points.note: 45 minutes more over burnt bush: the Cuernos above the lake.
